Package com.nutri_sci.database

Class DBManager

java.lang.Object
com.nutri_sci.database.DBManager
public class DBManager extends Object
Manages all database connections and operations for the NutriSci application.

The DBManager implements the Singleton pattern to ensure only one database connection exists throughout the application lifecycle. It provides comprehensive database access methods for user profiles, meals, food items, and nutritional data, serving as the primary data access layer for the application.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Managing database connections and initialization
  • User profile CRUD operations
  • Meal logging and retrieval
  • Food item searches and nutritional data lookups
  • Food group classifications and filtering
  • Nutritional analysis and ranking operations

The class automatically creates necessary application tables if they don't exist and provides robust error handling for database operations.
